original_query: What are the worst health disparity zones in Missouri based on uninsured rates?
modified_query: Which Missouri counties have the most people without health insurance?
modification_rationale: Testing conversational phrasing vs technical terminology. Original uses formal 'health disparity zones' and 'uninsured rates' while modified uses casual 'most people without health insurance'.

response_summary.title: Missouri's Uninsured Hotspots: Scotland County Leads State
response_summary.key_finding: Scotland County has the highest rate of uninsured residents in Missouri at 31.1%, more than triple the state average
response_summary.additional_context: These counties share characteristics of high vulnerability, including elevated poverty and disability rates. Morgan County has 19.3% poverty rate and 20.9% disability rate. All five counties rated 'High' on disaster vulnerability risk scale.
